desc: Fix a real footgun found on 2026-07-25: scripts/t6040-kbuild.sh names its outputs from the variant flags, so a DIET=1 build reused Image-hid-type-fix and CLOBBERED the live-proven 50.8 MiB ticket-100 kernel (recovered byte-exact from its untouched .gz, df7657c1). Give DIET=1 (and any future config-only variant) its own output basename, or refuse to overwrite an existing Image whose hash is referenced by a done/ writeup or ticket. Also consider a guard that refuses to overwrite any artifact hash pinned in tickets/. Small, offline, no rig.
author: claude
